title: Rewarming Step on the Dryer Rate for Grain Out of a Cold Bin
content:
Grain that has sat in a cold bin has to be warmed before it will give up water, so the dryer rate carries a second step under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements. The step turns on how long the grain has stood in store and on whether the bin has been aerated.

## Rule

Where the grain has stood in store longer than the rewarming day count of 90 calendar days and no aeration cycle has been run on the agreement, the rewarming step of 0.006 for each point on each bushel is added to the programme's rate.

Where the grain has stood in store longer than the rewarming day count and an aeration cycle has been run on the agreement, the light rewarming step of 0.003 for each point on each bushel is added.

And otherwise no step is added for the state of the bin.

Days in store are counted in whole calendar days from the storage start date through the day the pass is worked out.

## The branches side by side

| Days in store | An aeration cycle has been run on the agreement | Step added to the programme's rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| more than 90 | no | 0.006 |
| more than 90 | yes | 0.003 |
| 90 or fewer | no | none |
| 90 or fewer | yes | none |

The day count is read as strictly longer: grain that has stood exactly 90 days has not stood longer than the rewarming day count and carries no step; at 91 days it does.

## Worked steps, on hypothetical dates

Take a pass worked out on 18 February.

**Storage start date of 2 November, no aeration cycle on the agreement.** From 2 November to 18 February is 108 days, which is longer than 90, and the bin has not been aerated, so the rewarming step of 0.006 is added.

**Storage start date of 2 November, one aeration cycle run in December.** The same 108 days, but the bin has been aerated, so the light rewarming step of 0.003 is added.

**Storage start date of 5 January, no aeration cycle.** From 5 January to 18 February is 44 days, which is not longer than 90, so no step is added for the state of the bin.
